mapper.update: UPDATE tb_orders SET ORDER_STATUS = #{orderStatus}, CANCELLED_AT = CASE WHEN #{orderStatus} = '40' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE CANCELLED_AT END, UPDUSR_NO = #{updusrNo}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId}

UPDATE tb_orders SET BRANCH_DEPOSIT_STATUS = #{branchDepositStatus}, BRANCH_DEPOSIT_CONFIRMED_AT = CASE WHEN #{branchDepositStatus} = '20' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE BRANCH_DEPOSIT_CONFIRMED_AT END, UPDUSR_NO = #{updusrNo}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId}

UPDATE tb_orders SET DELIVERY_COMPANY_CODE = #{deliveryCompanyCode}, TRACKING_NO = #{trackingNo}, ORDER_STATUS = #{orderStatus}, SHIPPED_AT = CASE WHEN #{orderStatus} = '60' AND SHIPPED_AT IS NULL THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE SHIPPED_AT END, DELIVERED_AT = CASE WHEN #{orderStatus} = '70' AND DELIVERED_AT IS NULL THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE DELIVERED_AT END, UPDUSR_NO = #{updusrNo}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(PAID_AT) = CURDATE() AND ORDER_STATUS NOT IN ('40', '89') THEN TOTAL_PAY_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayTotalSales, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(PAID_AT) = CURDATE() AND ORDER_STATUS NOT IN ('40', '89') THEN TOTAL_PAY_AMOUNT - SUPPLY_PRICE_SUM ELSE 0 END), 0) AS estimatedProfit, COUNT(CASE WHEN ORDER_STATUS NOT IN ('10', '40', '20', '89') AND BRANCH_DEPOSIT_STATUS = '10' THEN 1 END) AS remittancePending, COUNT(CASE WHEN ORDER_STATUS IN ('30', '50', '60', '70', '99') AND MONTH(PAID_AT) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(PAID_AT) = YEAR(CURDATE()) THEN 1 END) AS completedOrders FROM tb_orders WHERE BRANCH_ID = #{branchId} AND ORDER_STATUS NOT IN ('10', '40', '20')

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN ORDER_STATUS IN ('30', '50') THEN 1 END) AS unprocessedOrders, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN BRANCH_DEPOSIT_STATUS = '10' THEN SUPPLY_PRICE_SUM ELSE 0 END), 0) AS branchPendingAmount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ORDER_STATUS = '30' AND SHIPPED_AT IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS shipmentPending, COUNT(CASE WHEN ORDER_STATUS = '60' THEN 1 END) AS inTransit FROM tb_orders WHERE ORDER_STATUS NOT IN ('10', '40', '20')

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM op_user) AS totalUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_branches) AS totalBranches, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_orders WHERE ORDER_STATUS NOT IN ('10', '40', '20')) AS totalOrders, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(TOTAL_PAY_AMOUNT), 0) FROM tb_orders WHERE ORDER_STATUS NOT IN ('10', '40', '20')) AS totalRevenue FROM DUAL

SELECT O.ORDER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(O.ORDERED_AT, '%Y.%m.%d %H:%i') AS ORDERED_AT, O.ORDER_NO, O.TOTAL_PAY_AMOUNT, O.SUPPLY_PRICE_SUM, (O.TOTAL_PAY_AMOUNT - O.SUPPLY_PRICE_SUM) AS MY_PROFIT, O.BRANCH_DEPOSIT_STATUS, O.DELIVERY_COMPANY_CODE, (SELECT CODE_NM FROM op_code WHERE GROUP_ID = 'R010660' AND CODE = O.DELIVERY_COMPANY_CODE) AS DELIVERY_COMPANY_NM, (SELECT CODE_NM FROM op_code WHERE GROUP_ID = 'R010650' AND CODE = O.ORDER_STATUS) AS ORDER_STATUS_NM, O.TRACKING_NO, O.ORDER_STATUS, O.DELIVERED_AT FROM tb_orders O WHERE O.BRANCH_ID = #{branchId} AND O.ORDER_STATUS NOT IN ('10', '40', '20') ORDER BY O.ORDERED_AT DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT O.ORDER_ID, B.BRANCH_NAME, O.ORDER_NO, O.SUPPLY_PRICE_SUM, O.BRANCH_DEPOSIT_STATUS, O.DELIVERY_COMPANY_CODE, (SELECT CODE_NM FROM op_code WHERE GROUP_ID = 'R010660' AND CODE = O.DELIVERY_COMPANY_CODE) AS DELIVERY_COMPANY_NM, (SELECT CODE_NM FROM op_code WHERE GROUP_ID = 'R010650' AND CODE = O.ORDER_STATUS) AS ORDER_STATUS_NM, O.TRACKING_NO, O.ORDER_STATUS, O.DELIVERED_AT FROM tb_orders O JOIN tb_branches B ON O.BRANCH_ID = B.BRANCH_ID WHERE O.ORDER_STATUS NOT IN ('10', '40', '20') ORDER BY O.ORDERED_AT DESC LIMIT 5
